answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake that is released only after a long, verifiable work history, so a Sybil farmer must fund every fake identity separately. Like a comet that burns fuel on every pass, each island of sock-puppet accounts becomes expensive to sustain, while honest agents build reputation on a basalt-solid record of completed tasks. If one identity misbehaves, its stake is slashed and its history void, so creating thousands of throwaway agents costs far more than the rewards they could extract.
